initiatives.name: Strategic M&A Portfolio (FY26)
initiatives.summary: Experian completed four acquisitions during FY26 focused on strengthening identity and data assets and expanding addressable markets, including AtData for email intelligence and Own Up for mortgage capabilities.

evidence.title: AtData Acquisition for Digital Identity Enhancement
evidence.summary: Experian acquired AtData, LLC and two related undertakings in the USA on 18 February 2026. AtData is a leading data and email intelligence company that strengthens Experian's digital identity and fraud prevention capabilities.
evidence.quote: the acquisition of AtData, LLC (AtData), and two related undertakings, in the USA on 18 February 2026, a leading data and email intelligence company that strengthens our digital identity and fraud prevention capabilities

evidence.title: KYC360 Acquisition for Financial Crime Compliance
evidence.summary: Experian acquired KYC Global Technologies Limited (KYC360) in Jersey, together with its subsidiary undertakings, on 24 October 2025. This acquisition enhances Experian's fraud prevention and financial crime compliance capabilities.
evidence.quote: the acquisition of KYC Global Technologies Limited (KYC360) in Jersey, together with its subsidiary undertakings, on 24 October 2025, enhancing our fraud prevention and financial crime compliance capabilities

evidence.title: ClearSale Acquisition for Digital Fraud Prevention
evidence.summary: Experian completed the acquisition of Clear Sale S.A. (ClearSale), a leading provider of digital fraud prevention solutions in Brazil on 1 April 2025. This acquisition strengthens Experian's fraud prevention capabilities in the Brazilian market.
evidence.quote: the acquisition of Clear Sale S.A. (ClearSale) and its subsidiary undertakings on 1 April 2025, a leading provider of digital fraud prevention solutions in Brazil

evidence.title: AtData acquisition for email intelligence capabilities
evidence.summary: Experian acquired US-based data intelligence business AtData, adding more than 10 billion email addresses to strengthen identity infrastructure and enhance digital channel support for clients.
evidence.quote: We acquired US-based data intelligence business AtData and added more than 10 billion email addresses to our data assets. This strengthens our identity infrastructure and enhances the support we provide to clients across digital channels.

evidence.title: Own Up acquisition for mortgage marketplace expansion
evidence.summary: Experian acquired Own Up, an AI-powered mortgage platform, to extend consumer marketplace into the mortgage space and create differentiated propositions for consumers and lenders.
evidence.quote: Own Up, an AI-powered mortgage platform, extends our consumer marketplace into the mortgage space, which, combined with Experian's housing data and scaled membership base, allows the creation of significantly differentiated proposition for consumers and lenders, simplifying the mortgage journey and improving access to relevant offers.

evidence.title: Four strategic acquisitions totaling US$792m
evidence.summary: Experian completed four acquisitions during FY26 focused on strengthening identity and data assets and expanding addressable markets, including AtData for email intelligence and Own Up for mortgage capabilities.
evidence.quote: During the year, we completed four acquisitions totalling US$792m, focused on strengthening our identity and data assets and expanding addressable markets.

initiatives.name: Cloud Technology Transformation Programme
initiatives.summary: Experian incurred US$28 million in restructuring costs related to completing technology transformation and cloud migration, including staff realignment and acceleration of shift to global development centres.

evidence.title: Cloud technology transformation substantially complete
evidence.summary: Experian's cloud technology transformation is now substantially complete, enabling cloud-native operations with increased agility and improved capital efficiency, with material cost savings expected from FY27.
evidence.quote: Our cloud technology transformation is now substantially complete, enabling Experian to operate as a cloud‑native organisation with increased agility and improved capital efficiency. As expected, we remain on track to deliver material cost savings from FY27 onwards, as dual‑run costs begin to decline.

evidence.title: US$28m technology transformation restructuring costs
evidence.summary: Experian incurred US$28 million in restructuring costs related to completing technology transformation and cloud migration, including staff realignment and acceleration of shift to global development centres.
evidence.quote: For the year ended 31 March 2026, expenses of US$28m (2025: US$50m) have been presented as restructuring costs, within Exceptional items, relating to this programme.

initiatives.name: AI Productivity & Market Opportunity Development
initiatives.summary: Experian has identified over US$15 billion of AI-enabled addressable market opportunities in Health, agentic commerce, Ascend platform expansion and embedded consumer marketplaces.

evidence.title: AI driving 10-15% coding productivity gains
evidence.summary: Experian is embedding AI across products, platforms and workflows, achieving measurable efficiency gains with 10-15% uplift in coding productivity and select areas achieving over 30% gains.
evidence.quote: It is already driving measurable efficiency gains, with a c.10-15% uplift in coding productivity in FY26, and select areas achieving gains of over 30%.

evidence.title: US$15bn AI-enabled market opportunities identified
evidence.summary: Experian has identified over US$15 billion of AI-enabled addressable market opportunities in Health, agentic commerce, Ascend platform expansion and embedded consumer marketplaces.
evidence.quote: We have already identified over US$15bn of AI-enabled addressable market opportunities, in Health, agentic commerce, Ascend platform expansion and embedded consumer marketplaces, and we are positioning the business to penetrate these emerging areas.

initiatives.name: Sustainability Emissions Reduction
initiatives.summary: Experian achieved a 90% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions since 2019, with 93% of electricity backed by renewable sources, supporting science-based targets to limit global warming to 1.5°C.

evidence.title: 90% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions since 2019
evidence.summary: Experian achieved a 90% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions since 2019, with 93% of electricity backed by renewable sources, supporting science-based targets to limit global warming to 1.5°C.
evidence.quote: Since 2019, we have reduced Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 90%. 93% of our total electricity was backed by renewable energy certificates or came from renewable sources, up from 87% in FY25.

initiatives.name: Workforce Expansion
initiatives.summary: Experian increased its global workforce from 23,300 to 25,200 employees as of March 2026, representing growth in talent to support business expansion.

evidence.title: Headcount increased to 25,200 employees
evidence.summary: Experian increased its global workforce from 23,300 to 25,200 employees as of March 2026, representing growth in talent to support business expansion.

initiatives.name: Consumer Services Membership Expansion
initiatives.summary: Experian's Consumer Services platform now supports over 215 million free members globally, expanding from traditional credit bureau services to comprehensive financial health tools including insurance, budgeting, and identity protection.

evidence.title: Consumer Services membership exceeds 215 million globally
evidence.summary: Experian's Consumer Services platform now supports over 215 million free members globally, expanding from traditional credit bureau services to comprehensive financial health tools including insurance, budgeting, and identity protection.
evidence.quote: Experian Consumer Services now supports over 215 million members globally with tools to help them potentially save on car insurance, find the right credit card, lower bills and cancel subscriptions, manage budgets, protect their identity and more.

initiatives.name: Share Repurchase Programme
initiatives.summary: Experian announced an initial US$1 billion share repurchase programme expected to complete in first half of FY27, plus an additional US$1 billion programme valid to June 2027.

evidence.title: US$1 billion share repurchase programme announced
evidence.summary: Experian announced an initial US$1 billion share repurchase programme expected to complete in first half of FY27, plus an additional US$1 billion programme valid to June 2027.
evidence.quote: This includes an initial US$1bn share repurchase programme, announced on 30 January 2026 and expected to complete during the first half of FY27, and an additional US$1bn share repurchase programme valid to 30 June 2027.

initiatives.name: Technology Infrastructure Capital Commitments
initiatives.summary: Experian has committed capital expenditure of $49 million for contracts already placed, with $34 million for intangible assets (primarily software) and $15 million for property, plant and equipment. $25 million of these commitments are not expected to be incurred before 31 March 2027.

evidence.title: Capital Commitments for Technology and Infrastructure
evidence.summary: Experian has committed capital expenditure of $49 million for contracts already placed, with $34 million for intangible assets (primarily software) and $15 million for property, plant and equipment. $25 million of these commitments are not expected to be incurred before 31 March 2027.
evidence.quote: Capital expenditure for which contracts have been placed: Other intangible assets 34, Property, plant and equipment 15, 49 47

initiatives.name: Leadership Transition - Chair Appointment
initiatives.summary: Adam Crozier joined as non-executive director in May 2026 and will assume the Chair role at the 2026 AGM, succeeding Mike Rogers who will retire after nine years.

evidence.title: Adam Crozier appointed as new Chair
evidence.summary: Adam Crozier joined as non-executive director in May 2026 and will assume the Chair role at the 2026 AGM, succeeding Mike Rogers who will retire after nine years.
evidence.quote: As announced on 21 April 2026, Adam Crozier joined the Board as a non‑executive director on 12 May 2026 and, subject to shareholder approval, will assume the role of Chair at the conclusion of the 2026 Annual General Meeting, at which point I will retire from the Board.
